title: Concept: Spring Actuator heap dump reachable
description: A Spring Actuator heap dump reference in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A heap dump contains every object in memory, including session tokens, password hashes and the customer records the service was processing.
applicability: Deployments that render a Spring Actuator heap dump reference into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A heap dump contains every object in memory, including session tokens, password hashes and the customer records the service was processing.
